title.rendered: Stick War: Legacy Mod APK 2026.1.787 (Unlimited Gems)

content.rendered:
Stick War: Legacy Mod (Unlimited Gems) is a popular stick figure game on the web, where you have the ability to control army of other stick figures to defeat your enemies, mine gold and more.

You can also learn how to use weapons such as Sword, Spear, Archer, Mage and even invite the giant to help you fight in the game. Further more destroy enemies statues and capture there territory.

Play mission modes which is usually open or available every Friday of the week for you to manage your army of stick man figures.

SCREENSHOT

Every progress map comes with its own rewards as you play the game everyday. Unlock in-game crowns as you pass through different difficultly level such as normal, hard and insane.

There are other types of game play available in the Stick War Legacy game such as tripple barricaded gold, death match, statue forward, also meet mini bosses and fight them.

Every stick Man army unit is equipped with his weapon, you can also see damage animation and blood effects when attacking your enemy or when the enemy attacks you.

Features

  • Classic campaign.
  • Zombie Survival Mode.
  • Tournament mode.
  • Skins available for you to change appearance of characters. Also unlock powerful weapons or upgrade them to deal high damage to the enemies.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How do I update the app?

A: Simply download the new version from our site and install it over the old one. Do not uninstall the old version if you want to keep your progress.
